cohort: Women with one previous lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) who underwent trial of labor (TOLAC) and delivered their current pregnancy at Hospital Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM), Kelantan, Malaysia, between January 01, 2016, and December 31, 2017.
finding: Factors significantly associated with repeat CS were no history of vaginal delivery, estimated fetal weight ≥3500 grams, and presence of meconium-stained liquor.
